tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ads_studio_add_product
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Add a product to Ads Studio - under a brand, or with no brand at all - from its page link and/or a pasted description. Answers as soon as the row is queued - Ads Studio reads the page in the background. Do not poll and do not list products to check. Read ads_studio_get_product when the user asks about it. Use this when the research missed a product or the user names a new one. To refresh an existing product from its page, pass its id in overwrite instead of adding a second row. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ads_studio_cancel_run
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Cancel a queued or running Ads Studio generation. Pictures already rendered stay; a run too far along to stop answers that it can no longer be canceled. Only cancel when the user asks. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ads_studio_create_brand
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Research a brand from its website and build its Ads Studio brand profile: products, palette, logo, tone and audience, read from the live site. Pass the website when you have it - with a URL the research starts at once and takes a few minutes; with only a name Ads Studio answers with the site it thinks was meant and starts nothing, so confirm that with the user and call again with the URL. This reads the brand's own public website. It does not design logos or brand assets (that is the brand-asset-creation workflow) and it is not the Marketing Studio brand-kit record (marketing_create_brand_kit). Before the first Ads Studio call in a conversation, load the Ads Studio instructions with get_preset_instructions and preset 'ads-studio'. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ads_studio_generate
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Generate ad creatives in Ads Studio: for a brand, for products of any brand or of none, or from a prompt and the user's pictures alone, with or without the brand kit. Ads Studio writes the concepts and renders the pictures. This spends Higgsfield credits, so quote with ads_studio_quote and get explicit approval of the exact allocation and credit cost first. An approval from the Ads Studio app allocation is NOT approval. When allocation is supplied, this tool quotes the whole allocation and requests native MCP form confirmation when supported. Otherwise it returns approval_required and credits: show the exact counts and cost, ask for explicit chat approval and stop. Only after approval, repeat the unchanged allocation with expected_credits. Never split the allocation or bypass a supported native form. Answers as soon as the runs are accepted, with a run id each - report those and stop; read ads_studio_get_run when the user asks, never in a loop. Generation takes a few minutes. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ads_studio_get_brand
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Read one Ads Studio brand: how far its research got through the five stages (gather, synthesis, enrichment, products, assets) and what is already usable. Use this to answer "is the research done?" - status done means the brand and its products are ready. Call it when the user asks, not on a timer, and never in a loop: research can take several minutes. Follow next_step: a finished research is offered for ads, never generated on its own. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ads_studio_get_product
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Read one Ads Studio product and open it as a card: whether Ads Studio has finished reading its page (status queued, in_progress, completed or failed, with fail_reason when it failed) and what it knows - name, price, page, description, selling points. Use this to answer "is the product ready?" after ads_studio_add_product, when the user asks - not on a timer and never in a loop. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ads_studio_get_run
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Read one Ads Studio generation run: its status and every concept in it, with the ad copy. Opens the generation card, which shows the pictures - there is no image link in the result and none to ask for. Call it when the user asks about a run - never on your own initiative and never in a loop. A run can read done while its pictures are still rendering, so check still_rendering before telling the user the ads are ready. A queued run carries its place in line; a canceled run stays canceled and is not a failure. Name a creative by its concept_id. These pictures are not ordinary generations: do not pass Ads Studio ids to show_generation_by_ids or jobs_wait. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ads_studio_list_brands
tools.description:
Every image and video model

List the brands in this account's Higgsfield Ads Studio, with each one's research status and how many products it has, and open them as a card the user can browse. Call this when the user talks about advertising an existing brand, so later tools get a real brand_id; when the list is already in this conversation, reuse its ids instead of listing again. This is Ads Studio, the ad-creative workspace: it is not the Marketing Studio brand-kit record (marketing_list_brand_kits) and it does not create or design brand assets. Before the first Ads Studio call in a conversation, load the Ads Studio instructions with get_preset_instructions and preset 'ads-studio': it carries the frames, objectives and the research-then-offer flow. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ads_studio_list_products
tools.description:
Every image and video model

List Ads Studio products and open them as a card the user can browse: name, price, page, how many pictures it has, whether the brand page shows it (picked_for_ads) and whether its ad copy is ready. With brand_id: that brand's products. Without it: every product the user has - of any brand or of none - a page at a time. Use product_id in ads_studio_quote and ads_studio_generate: a generation advertises exactly the products named there, whatever picked_for_ads says. texts_ready=false means the copy is still being written and ads made from it come out weaker. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ads_studio_list_runs
tools.description:
Every image and video model

List recent Ads Studio generation runs, newest first, optionally for one brand. Use it to find a run whose id was lost, or to check what is already in flight before starting another batch. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ads_studio_quote
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Get the cost without starting a generation, reserving credits or spending credits. A user request to create ads, including an exact allocation submitted from the Ads Studio app, authorizes this read-only quote: do not ask for separate permission to quote. Takes the same arguments as ads_studio_generate so the quote matches the run. After quoting a requested generation, show the exact allocation and total credits; use ask_user_input (or ask_user_input_v3) only when that exact host tool is available, otherwise ask one concise chat question. Never invent a host tool or generate before explicit approval of this allocation and cost. A price-only request needs only the quote, not a spending-approval question. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ads_studio_update_product
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Change one Ads Studio product, or hide it from the brand page. picked_for_ads=false hides it and true shows it again; neither deletes anything, and a generation still advertises exactly the products it names. Every other field is a merge patch: what you leave out is left alone. Use the user's own words for the copy fields; do not invent selling points they did not say. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ai_influencer_generate
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Generate and save one to four AI Influencer character sheets in the selected Higgsfield workspace from exact params returned by ai_influencer_prepare. Does not train a Soul or generate video. Rechecks price before submission and rejects paid prices above max_credits. Paid generation spends existing credits; it does not purchase credits or subscriptions. use_free_gens=true requires explicit user intent and backend eligibility, with max_credits=0 for free-only requests; never falls back to paid generation. Returns job_id for the first accepted job and job_ids for a batch before completion; wait for every returned job. Free generations always submit one sheet. Repeating this call can create another job and spend credits again; never automatically retry an uncertain submission. An auto-updating generation widget shows every accepted sheet and its progress. Wait with jobs_wait (timeout_seconds <= 15); do not call show_generation_by_ids or job_display again unless the user requests a separate display. After completion, offer Genjutsu animation and wait for agreement before opening motion presets. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ai_influencer_get_options
tools.description:
Every image and video model

List available AI Influencer character traits for human and animal tiers. Optionally filter by tier; returns option IDs and tier constraints for ai_influencer_prepare. Does not randomize, quote, create or save a character. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ai_influencer_get_settings
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Read reusable settings from an existing AI Influencer sheet using its job_id. Returns human or animal traits, identity and Style references, body color and saved appearance variants when present. Does not replay the original batch count, quote, save or generate an image. Pass returned params to ai_influencer_prepare with randomize=false to preserve the design. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ai_influencer_list_presets
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Browse AI Influencer character-sheet presets with previews and reusable settings. Does not generate a sheet. Pass selected preset settings to ai_influencer_prepare with randomize=false. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_ai_influencer_prepare
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Prepare an AI Influencer character design and quote the total credit cost for batch_size (one to four sheets, default one) without creating a job or spending credits. Accepts human or animal tiers, traits, brief, seed, at most one confirmed identity image in medias and up to three Style references in item_medias. Preserves animal-v3 look and animal trait choices from saved settings; FNF validates variant IDs against the current catalog. Default randomize=true fills unspecified traits using builder shuffle rules; reference identity traits stay unset unless explicitly selected. randomize=false preserves explicit settings and defaults tier to freak (Bold). Returns exact params, credits and free_gens_remaining when known. For generation, pass these params unchanged to ai_influencer_generate; preview-only requests stop here. Repeating preparation may produce a different random design. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_balance
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Read-only balance: credits, workspace plan, free generations (free_gens — Genjutsu on generate_video, Viral on execute_preset, and AI Influencer Builder via its Use free gens toggle), and free-trial state (free_trial.unlim_available says whether unlimited generations can be spent). Call it for credits / plan / trial questions or after an out-of-credits error. Report the current balance and entitlement state, and explain any insufficient-credit limitation. Do not provide pricing links, purchase or upgrade directions, or trial-start instructions. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_canvas_add
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Add items to an existing Higgsfield canvas board in the authenticated user's workspace: sticky notes, text, shapes, images, image and video generation nodes, and connections between items. It does not create pages; page_id puts an item on a page that is already on the board. Use it when the user asks to put something on a board; canvas_update changes existing items and canvas_remove deletes them. Added items are saved to the board and appear live for everyone viewing it, including an open_canvas view already shown: do not call open_canvas again to refresh it. A generation item saves its model, prompt and settings only: this tool does not start generation or charge generation credits; canvas_run does. Give a generation item only the settings the user asked for: the others stay the model's defaults, and the result lists the settings each generation node got and any value the model did not take. An image item imports a Higgsfield generation or upload image URL into the user's Higgsfield media; unsupported URL origins are rejected before the board changes, and imported media may remain even if adding to the board fails. A connection into a generation node feeds it: the source (an image, a video, another generation node's result, or text for the prompt) fills the node's matching free input (an image fills reference images before a start or end frame; set the connection's input to choose, e.g. start_image for an exact first frame), and canvas_run uses it. That is how to generate from an image on a board, e.g. image to video. Between other items a connection draws an arrow. Give items a key to connect them in the same call; connect to items an earlier call added by the ids it returned. To add more than 5 items, make several calls of up to 5 items each, in the order a person would lay them out (a card or a step at a time), so everyone viewing the board sees it grow, and set final on your last change to the board. Additions can partially apply: inspect applied and rejected before retrying, since repeating an addition creates duplicates. Returns the new items' ids in order, and each connection's id and the input it fills. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_canvas_create
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Create a new private canvas board and return its room_id and canvas_url. The board opens for the user and shows later canvas_add, canvas_update and canvas_remove changes and canvas_run results live, so open_canvas is not needed for it. Use the room_id with canvas_read, canvas_add, canvas_update, canvas_remove and canvas_run. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_canvas_read
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Read a canvas board: every node with its id, type, position, size and text, grouped by page, and the arrows between them. Filter by types, text query or node_ids on big boards. Read before adding so new items do not overlap existing ones, and for the node and edge ids that canvas_update and canvas_remove take. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_canvas_remove
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Delete items and connections from a Higgsfield canvas board in the authenticated user's workspace. Use it only when the user asks to delete something: pass node ids and edge ids from canvas_read or canvas_add. Deletions are saved to the board and appear live for everyone viewing it, including an open_canvas view already shown. Some deletions can be rejected while others apply: inspect applied and rejected. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_canvas_run
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Run generation nodes on a canvas board (and the nodes they depend on). Generations cost credits: first call with confirm=false. Nothing starts, and it returns the price of each charged generation and the total. Give the user one answer with what will run, its settings and that total, and only after they agree call again with confirm=true. A generation without a price is named as such: tell the user instead of estimating it. Price board nodes here, not with estimate_image_cost or estimate_video_cost: those name board models differently. Results appear in their nodes on the board live, including an open_canvas view already shown (do not open it again); read them with canvas_read include_results=true. To generate on a board, add generation items and the connections that feed them with canvas_add and run them here: generate_image and generate_video results do not land on a board. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_canvas_update
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Change existing items on a Higgsfield canvas board in the authenticated user's workspace: move them, resize them, or replace the text of sticky notes, text blocks and shapes. Each change names a node id from canvas_read or canvas_add and gives a new position (x and y), a new size (width and height), new text, or several of these. Use it when the user asks to rearrange, resize or reword items; canvas_add adds items and canvas_remove deletes them. New values overwrite the old ones, are saved to the board and appear live for everyone viewing it, including an open_canvas view already shown. Changes can partially apply: inspect applied and rejected before retrying. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_create_folder
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Create one subfolder in an existing Higgsfield media project. Use project_id returned by create_project in this conversation or explicitly supplied by the user. Omit parent_folder_id to create directly under the root. Keep using the project's default_folder_id for generation unless the user wants outputs in this subfolder; then pass its folder_id. This does not create a project or a local filesystem folder. Creation is not idempotent: do not automatically retry after a timeout or uncertain result. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_create_project
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Create a private Higgsfield media project for this conversation. Create only on an explicit user request or when get_preferences returns auto_create_project=true and this conversation has no destination. The default is no automatic project. An explicit existing destination or request to work without a project wins. Creating a project does not change the saved preference. Call once, then retain project_id, workspace_id and default_folder_id in this conversation and pass folder_id on subsequent generate_* calls. Reuse the existing project on later turns; never create one per generation or reuse another conversation's project. This does not create a chat, website or 3D scene. No starter/brief subfolder is created. Resolve workspace_id before the first call using list_workspaces (full) or workspace_list (OpenAI); use the selected workspace or ask the user when ambiguous. Repeat an uncertain request only with the original workspace_id, name, surface and idempotency_key, even if the selected workspace changes; backend replay lasts 15 minutes, not the lifetime of the chat. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_create_website
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Start a new full-stack website. Creates the website and a git repo: a React 19 + TanStack Start app, server-rendered, in ONE Cloudflare Worker, with D1 / R2 / KV / Durable Objects / Containers available (all DISABLED by default). Returns a website_id — pass it to every later website tool. The 'type' param is REQUIRED and is the USER'S choice, not yours: unless the user has already made it unambiguous, ASK the user whether they want a plain website (no Higgsfield integration) or a Higgsfield-integrated app (Sign in with Higgsfield + AI image/video generation via the Higgsfield SDK) BEFORE calling this tool. Apps are scaffolded from a v2 starter template and REQUIRE the 'template' param — pick the closest of studio / preset / app-detail per the template param's guide ('custom' is ONLY for when the user explicitly says "use custom template" — never pick it yourself). The chosen layout ships as real code already wired as the home page; you ADAPT IT IN PLACE, never rebuild it. Websites take an OPTIONAL template: pass 'scroll-scrub' for an animated website (its scrub engine ships pre-built) and omit it for a non-animated one. App and website templates are not interchangeable — a cross-kind name is rejected. Workflow: (0) use the installed website-builder skill and its bundled references FIRST to load the stack, design contract, and hard rules (REQUIRED before building or editing); (1) create_website; (2) call website_repo_access with checkout, edit/commit using sandbox_exec, then website_repo_access with push (for apps, read app/src/layouts/AGENTS.md + app/src/components/AGENTS.md right after cloning); (3) deploy_website to ship it live — and deploy again after ANY later change (publish_website only lists what is already live; it does not deploy). This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_deploy_website
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Build and deploy the website via CI, then return its live URL. Every deploy ships the live site at the website's public URL (there is no separate preview stage). IMPORTANT: commit and git push ALL your changes BEFORE calling this — the build runs from the pushed repo. Deploy again after ANY later change: publish_website does NOT deploy (it only lists the already-live build on the community feed), so this tool is the only way changes ship. A failed build returns the log; a still-running build returns status 'pending' — call website_status to check. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_estimate_image_cost
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Estimate image generation credit cost without submitting a job. HTTPS image references are fetched, uploaded, and confirmed in your Higgsfield media library; repeated calls can create new uploads. Requires write access. Takes the same `params` object as generate_image: `params.model` is required; `prompt` may be omitted for a cost-only estimate. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_estimate_video_cost
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Estimate video generation credit cost without submitting a job. HTTPS image references are fetched, uploaded, and confirmed in your Higgsfield media library; repeated calls can create new uploads. Requires write access. Takes the same `params` object as generate_video: `params.model` is required; `prompt` and `duration` may be omitted (model defaults apply). For a Genjutsu recreation, preserve supplied reference images with role image and the confirmed driving/source video with role video in params.medias. Copying actions or camera movement uses hf_mult_motion_control; replacing a subject uses hf_mult_replace_object. A video-only price quote does not establish that all inputs for the requested recreation are ready. For custom follow-ups to a Genjutsu catalog video, resolve get_preset_instructions({preset:"genjutsu"}) before preflight; the current request determines the model, not the catalog recipe. Price-only requests may omit reference images and must respect any no-upload instruction. Preparing a complete request requires the supplied images and one confirmed video; ask about conflicting upload instructions. Read input_check for missing roles and reuse prepared_params with resolved UUIDs. A successful quote never validates generation readiness. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_execute_preset
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Request execution of one published preset from the Viral or Marketing Studio gallery. A bare preset slash command or a request to open, preview, or browse a preset only opens its widget. For supplied attachments, use input_schema from get_preset_instructions to map and upload the relevant files before opening any widget. Call get_presets exactly once with source, preset_id and initial_inputs in the exact schema fields. Do not call get_presets just to inspect the schema. Leave omitted settings to schema defaults; never reopen the detail merely to repeat default selections. Never assume one photo satisfies all requirements or guess ambiguous slot assignments. Leave missing fields in the prefilled widget for the user. Stop after opening the detail and let the user interact with it. Do not call execute_preset unless the user explicitly asks to generate, or submits with Recreate in the widget. Check execution.readiness for the supplied inputs before execution; collect missing or invalid fields instead of submitting. execution.available indicates capability, not permission; optional inputs and built-in media do not authorize generation. Readiness checks input structure, not media ownership or upload confirmation; use only confirmed media IDs. If the widget reports submitted job IDs, display and wait for those jobs without executing again. Check execution.available in the preset detail before calling. Unavailable execution returns an error without submitting a job. Use get_presets to obtain the published preset_id and source; do not invent either value. A successful submission returns final job_ids; a preset may produce multiple outputs. Use job_display for one job, jobs_wait and show_generation_by_ids for multiple jobs. Preset-specific inputs are a free-form object; their requirements are defined by the selected preset, not by this tool schema. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_finish_home_workflow
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Finish tracking a Home-launched faceless workflow only when its supplied run_id is present in the request context. Use completed after the final verified video and selected cover are delivered; provide the confirmed final_video_media_id. Use cancelled only when the user stops the workflow, or failed when bounded recovery is exhausted. Questions, individual jobs and intermediate batches do not finish a workflow. Does not cancel backend jobs or regenerate media. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_generate_audio
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Generate speech/voice audio (text-to-speech). A successful submission returns job IDs; cost preflight and unlim_choice submit no job. Call it directly with the default model `seed_audio` (Seed Audio 1.0 by ByteDance) unless the user or an active skill requires a different engine. `seed_audio` needs an exact `voice_id` + `voice_type` pair ('preset' for a built-in voice, 'element' for one of the user's own). If either value is missing, call `list_voices` as the only tool in that turn so the user can choose. The picker returns the selected pair in a new user turn; continue the pending narration immediately with this tool using that pair. Never invent a voice_id. Optional tuning: `format`, `sample_rate`, `speech_rate` (-50..100), `loudness_rate` (-50..100), `pitch_rate` (-12..12). To use a specific named engine instead, set `model:'text2speech_v2'` and pass `variant` (one of elevenlabs|minimax|seed_speech|vibe_voice|cozy_voice) together with voice_type + voice_id. Use `models_get` / `models_search` to inspect a model's parameters. This tool only generates speech: it cannot generate music or sound effects — decline general music or sound-effect requests rather than substituting a speech model. All arguments go inside the single `params` object; `params.model` and `params.prompt` are required. `get_cost:true` returns the credit cost without submitting a job. This tool already displays its submitted jobs in an auto-updating generation widget, including while pending or in progress. Do not follow it with job_display, show_generations, or show_generation_by_ids merely to show or refresh the same results, before or after completion. To await completion, use jobs_wait with timeout_seconds <= 15; it does not open another widget. Use a separate display only when the user explicitly requests one or the workflow requires a distinct preview or approval. Headless generate_*_batch and execute_preset workflows follow their own display instructions. Submitted audio requests can send text and reference inputs to external audio model providers through Higgsfield and consume credits. On a transport timeout the submission outcome may be unknown: do not automatically resubmit. Reuse returned job IDs and retry only after the original outcome is known. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_generate_audio_batch
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Submit 1-6 independent audio generations in parallel without opening a widget. Requests can send text and reference inputs to external audio model providers through Higgsfield and consume credits. Each requests[] item accepts generation params with count fixed to 1 and no get_cost, creates one job on successful submission, and keeps its caller-provided index in the response. Use for multiple distinct prompts or inputs; use generate_audio for one user-facing generation. Poll returned job IDs with jobs_wait in agent-chosen groups of at most 8. For larger sets, collect indexed jobs across submission batches. After every job in the user's set is terminal, pass the collected jobs to exactly one show_generation_by_ids call for up to 24 jobs; never use show_generations or call job_display once per job. A partial failure or timeout does not make the whole batch safe to retry: keep returned job IDs and resolve unknown submission outcomes before retrying affected items. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_generate_image
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Generate an image. A successful submission returns job IDs; a choice or rejected request submits no job. For credit preflight use `estimate_image_cost` first; HTTPS image references are imported into your media library. Call this directly as the first tool call of the turn with the default model `gpt_image_2_5` for ordinary generation, photorealistic images, typography, and reference-based editing. Consult `models_recommend`, `models_search`, `models_list`, or `models_get` only when the user asks to pick or compare models, or you need `aspect_ratios`, `parameters`, or `medias[].roles` for reference inputs. Reference media can be uploaded media UUIDs from `media_upload_and_confirm`, completed generation job UUIDs, or authorized HTTPS image URLs such as user-provided file download URLs; the server imports HTTPS images into Higgsfield and confirms them automatically. For character/avatar requests use image generation directly; there is no reusable character-training flow here. All arguments go inside the single `params` object — `params.model` is required, `params.prompt` holds the text description, and model-specific parameters are additional keys of `params`. Server returns `adjustments` for fallbacks; invalid declared-param values return a structured error. This tool already displays its submitted jobs in an auto-updating generation widget, including while pending or in progress. Do not follow it with job_display, show_generations, or show_generation_by_ids merely to show or refresh the same results, before or after completion. To await completion, use jobs_wait with timeout_seconds <= 15; it does not open another widget. Use a separate display only when the user explicitly requests one or the workflow requires a distinct preview or approval. Headless generate_*_batch and execute_preset workflows follow their own display instructions. On a transport timeout the submission outcome may be unknown: do not automatically resubmit. Reuse returned job IDs and retry only after the original outcome is known. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_generate_image_batch
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Submit 1-6 independent image generations in parallel without opening a widget. tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_publish_website

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_sandbox_exec
tools.description:
Every image and video model

Execute a shell command in a remote Higgsfield cloud Linux sandbox — NOT your local machine or the client's own shell. Use it for Higgsfield media workflows and website_repo_access checkouts that require the hosted toolchain. Do not use it to inspect a local repository, install desktop software, or control applications on the user's computer. Preinstalled: ffmpeg/ffprobe, ImageMagick, sox, python3 with Pillow and faster-whisper, node/npm/npx, sharp-cli, Playwright with headless Chromium, caption fonts (Metropolis, Montserrat), zip/unzip, git, curl, jq. Use it for media processing (trim, convert, overlay, concat with ffmpeg), image manipulation, and packaging that dedicated Higgsfield tools do not cover. The sandbox is isolated per user and is discarded ~10 seconds after a call finishes, so files in /home/user only survive between back-to-back calls — chain multi-step work into a single command (&&) and export results before finishing, or expect to re-download inputs. It has internet access: bring files in with curl from media URLs (media_import_url or generation results). For an output created here, call media_upload BEFORE starting the producing command, then append `curl -f -X PUT --upload-file <file> '<upload_url>'` to that SAME command so the ephemeral file is uploaded before it exits; call media_confirm only after HTTP 200. Never pass a sandbox path to media_upload_and_confirm: that tool accepts only client attachments. Commands run in /home/user and time out after timeout_seconds (default 60, max 120); for longer work (large renders, installs) set background:true and poll the returned log/status files with later sandbox_exec calls. Background work receives a 15-minute sandbox lease, and shorter poll calls never reduce its remaining lifetime. Set restart:true to discard the sandbox and start clean. For actual visual inspection, pass image_paths (up to 4 PNG/JPEG paths, <=512 KiB total) with a foreground command: images are returned natively to the model, not as text or URLs.
